answer: Lever: latency-triangulated host uniqueness. Each epoch five beacon-picked verifiers on separate continents ping every key with a nonce; the round-trip times fix a position, and keys whose vertex lands within 2 ms of another share a single payout. A farm can add delay but never remove it, so 1,000 keys racked in one Jade data center turn their distinct-host story into a fable; they need 1,000 real sites at ~$5/key/month, ~$5,000/month, while an honest agent pays nothing.
